summary: This experimental document describes Proportional Rate Reduction (PRR), an alternative to Fast Recovery and Rate-Halving for deciding how much data TCP sends during loss recovery. PRR minimizes excess window adjustments so the window at the end of recovery is close to the target set by congestion control. It was later replaced by RFC 9937.

eli5.summary: After losing some packets, TCP slows down. PRR slows it smoothly so it lands at a good speed instead of crashing. It has been replaced by a newer document.
